posts.title: Pre-guest checklist for one-time cleaning in Greer
posts.text:
One time cleaning in Greer, SC is the easiest way to get the house ready before family arrives, and a short checklist keeps it from turning into a scramble. Whether your home is a historic place near Downtown Greer or a newer build close to GSP Airport, the list is the same.

Here is what a one-time visit from our team covers:
- Kitchen counters, sink and stovetop cleaned and degreased
- Bathrooms scrubbed and disinfected
- Bedrooms and living areas dusted
- Floors vacuumed and mopped
- Baseboards and door frames wiped by hand
- Mirrors and glass polished, trash emptied

The inside of the oven, the fridge and the cabinets can be added if you want them done too. A good rule before a holiday is to book a few days ahead, so you are not chasing a cleaner the night before guests walk in. Because every home is a different size and condition, we only give exact prices after a free in-home estimate, with no commitment. Tap Learn more to see what a one-time clean includes in Greer.

posts.title: How a free estimate works for Parker Airbnb hosts
posts.text:
If you host guests in a rental near the mill neighborhoods on Greenville's west side, Airbnb cleaning in Parker, SC starts with a simple free estimate. You book it, a member of our team comes to the property, and we walk through it together.

During that visit we look at the layout, the number of bedrooms and bathrooms, how the kitchen is set up and what your turnover window looks like between check-out and check-in. Parker sits in ZIP 29611 near US-123 and US-25, so we also plan around how quickly we can reach the property. After the walk-through, you get an exact price in writing. There is no commitment, and you decide whether it fits your calendar.

Once you book, each turnover follows the same routine: kitchen reset, bathrooms disinfected, beds made with your linens, floors done, trash out, supplies checked against your restocking list and a photo report if something is damaged or missing. Hosts who live out of town tell us that last part matters most. Tap Book to schedule your free in-home estimate in Parker.

posts.title: Winter cleaning for Gantt apartments and condos
posts.text:
Apartment cleaning in Gantt, SC looks a little different once the heat comes on and the windows stay shut. In the Upstate, November through February means less fresh air, so dust and pet hair settle on vents, shelves and baseboards faster than you would expect in a small space.

Three spots deserve extra attention in cooler months. First, the tracks of the balcony or patio door, where grit and moisture collect. Second, the air return and vent covers, which hold a gray film by midwinter. Third, the floors along the walls, where a vacuum often skips the edge. If you live in the residential neighborhoods south of downtown Greenville, close to I-85 and US-25, a quick wipe of these spots each week keeps the unit from feeling stale.

When you would rather hand it off, our team cleans kitchens, bathrooms, floors, baseboards and door frames by hand, sized to apartments, condos and townhomes. Exact prices come after a free in-home estimate, with no commitment. Tap Learn more to see what is included in Gantt.
